notes.title: MUTT Studio is Saying Goodbye
notes.notes:
MUTT Studio has decided to close its virtual doors. We have had a lot of fun building and enjoyed interacting with the community but we have decided to take on other ventures at this time. As a result, we will be taking the game off Steam. If you already have a copy of the game it will still work as expected.

Thank you all for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Update 1 Is Live!
notes.notes:
Reposting here for visibility on Store Page. 

Hi all! It's been one week since launch and we've been so excited to see everyone enjoying the game! We have been watching and listening closely and working hard to address bugs and improvements. We have fixed a lot of issues you all have brought to us, as well as made some improvements that should make the early game for new players quite a bit less punishing, while making late game more challenging.

Changes include:

-Improved tutorial to cover core concepts more thoroughly
-Added a Youtube playlist of gameplay in menu for newcomers (thanks youtubers!)
-Helped the likelihood you will receive trinkets early game 
-Added store reputation that explains what drives the likelihood of failed pitches
-Nerfed daily bonus money 
-You now receive patience when trinkets drop as well to help a bit during the day
-Customers now do more patience damage based on wealth level
-Strikes and patience now reset when moving stores
-Patience system clarified and visualized better
-Raising pay increases patience more modestly
-UI loading bug fixed
-Double strike bug fixed
-Debris config fixed
-Various display animation bugs fixed
-Day not ending bug seems fixed (was difficult to reproduce so waiting to be sure) 

Also, a note: we have tested saves from a previous version and it seems they should be unaffected by this patch. So keep on trucking!

We are still addressing some bugs and improvements, but we wanted to get this out to you all ASAP to show we are committed to making Assembly Required the best it can be. Stay tuned for future updates and exciting new content! Also, please don't forget to review the game on Steam if you are enjoying. We need more reviews!

Happy Holidays!
Walter

notes.title: WE ARE LIVE!
notes.notes:
It's been a long development journey (about 2 years), but we made it! We started this with a dream of making a fun, weird little game and doing it right. No early access. No microtransactions. Good performance. Great fun. We have worked hard to make it a reality for you all but the work isn't over.

We had a great Beta testing period over the last few months and thanks so much to our testers! We have decided instead of doing a drawing for free copies like we planned, you all get free copies because you're just that awesome! Thanks for helping us improve the game and tutorial as we approached release!

Now that we are here, the work begins of making sure everyone is having the best time possible. We know there may be issues. If there is something that really hinders your enjoyment of the game, please let us know so we can try to address it! 

Email us at themutts@muttstudiogames.com and we will get on it. We are already working on our first update with bugfixes and balance tweaks, and we'll be sure to add your issue to our list. 

Thanks so much for playing and please share the game in any way you can if you enjoyed it! We are small devs and have no marketing budget. You are it! 

Happy Mazing!
Walter

notes.title: Build the most confusing furniture store possible in Assembly Required
notes.notes:
Assembly Required is a management sim that's all about engineering the dreaded feeling of emerging from a furniture store, wondering what day it is and absolutely despising the smell of leather. You play as the manager of a furniture store, and it's your job to create a maze of displays and merchandise that no customer can escape without losing some of their money, and any good mood they may have entered with. 

Developer MUTT Studio describes Assembly Required as a mix of tower defense and sim elements. Building your store really does look like placing turrets in a game like Sanctum, but instead of dishing out maximum damage, you lay paths to split and funnel waves of customers, ensuring they waste as much time and view as much merchandise as possible. I am positive this is how furniture stores are actually built. 

On the other hand, you've got to manage employees and staff different departments, including QA, sales and, hilariously enough, customer service. Different types of customers require different shepherding, you see, and you've got to confuse the hell out of them while keeping them just happy enough. 

Assembly Required will release this summer.

Thanks, RockPaperShotgun.

notes.title: Assembly Required is an IKEA simulator
notes.notes: The navigational nightmare of an IKEA store is the stuff of legend uninspiring stand-up comics. But now it s in a videogame too. Assembly Required is a parody sim about building a furniture maze designed to bamboozle your customers and weaken their their wallet fingers. You want to exhaust the shop’s visitors with a gauntlet of armchairs, ottomans, dining tables and heart-shaped beds, while enjoying a mix of Tycoon and Tower Defense gameplay . Wanna see the trailer? Just go that way, past the dog baths, left at the coffee hammocks, through the forest of lamps, turn right at curtain canyon, and left again at the meatball graveyard. Can t miss it. (more…)
